title: A Polish audit found a JASSM-ER settlement evidence gap without establishing missile delivery quantity
source_unit: Polish Supreme Audit Office review of 2022 defence-budget execution and FMS settlement controls
geography: Poland and US-origin JASSM-ER procurement/accounting relationship

denominator.unit: DD Form 645 settlement forms reviewed by NIK

observations.method: Official audit-text extraction; JASSM-ER-specific passage kept separate from the report's unrelated 32-unit delivery comparator.
observations.uncertainty: The audit passage concerns settlement documentation and does not identify a missile lot, accepted quantity, shipment, or fielding status.
observations.subgroup: JASSM-ER production-cost settlement line within the reviewed Polish FMS documentation sample.
observations.counterinterpretation: Missing numeric support in the reviewed material may reflect an accounting/documentation gap rather than absent production or delivery.

denominator.unit: advance-funded contracts from 2014–2021 examined by NIK

separate_contract_delivered_units.unit: units delivered by end-2022 after third amendment

jassm_er_assignment.unit: not identified as JASSM in cited passage

observations.method: Retained as a general Polish defence-procurement schedule/quantity comparator, not joined to the JASSM-ER line.
observations.uncertainty: The cited passage does not disclose the comparator contract's equipment type, so no JASSM inference is permitted.
observations.subgroup: Separate delayed/amended contract in NIK's advance-settlement sample.
observations.counterinterpretation: The delivery ratio may reflect a contract-specific scope or amendment history and is not a general Polish procurement rate.

related_sources.claim: Detailed finding preserves the JASSM-ER-specific control gap and separate 32-unit comparator.
Current 2024 JASSM-ER order still lacks a reviewed public delivery/acceptance record.

boundary: This record establishes an audited documentation/control gap for a JASSM-ER production-cost settlement and separately reports a non-JASSM-attributed 32-unit comparator. It does not estimate production, acceptance, delivery, fielding, operational readiness, delay, or geopolitical leverage for the 2024 Polish JASSM-ER order.
